description.en: GitHub README badges and status shields styled with clean shadcn aesthetics.
description.zh: 以 shadcn 极简美学重新绘制的 GitHub 项目徽标与状态盾牌。

content.en: shieldcn modernises software repository badges by bringing the clean, monochrome aesthetic of shadcn/ui to GitHub READMEs. Moving away from outdated plastic badge styles, shieldcn delivers refined SVG shields with crisp typography and subtle micro-borders.
content.zh: shieldcn 以现代排版与黑白极简主义重新定义了开源仓库中的状态徽标（Badges）。告别了十几年前 Shields.io 固化的圆角塑料质感，shieldcn 引入了精妙的细微单像素描边、干净的无衬线字体与精准对比度，让项目的 README 瞬间呈现出高端工业质感。
